pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which player mainly tries to stop the shooter? (1 mark)
   A. GS
   B. C
   C. GK
   D. WA

2. What should you do after passing the ball? (1 mark)
   A. Walk off the court
   B. Close your eyes
   C. Sit down
   D. Move into space to receive it again

3. When is an overhead pass most useful? (1 mark)
   A. When a defender is standing close
   B. When resting
   C. When you are alone on the court
   D. When shooting from far

4. Which of these is a light tone of purple? (1 mark)
   A. Purple mixed with brown
   B. Purple mixed with white
   C. Purple mixed with black
   D. Pure purple

5. What is a good way to blend the edges of two tones? (1 mark)
   A. With sand
   B. With a damp brush
   C. With a dry stone
   D. With a knife

6. Which pieces should be pasted first in a montage? (1 mark)
   A. The smallest pieces
   B. The back pieces
   C. The front pieces
   D. The title only

7. How many secondary colours are there on the basic colour wheel? (1 mark)
   A. Nine
   B. Three
   C. Two
   D. Six

8. Free hand lettering means writing letters (1 mark)
   A. with a printing machine
   B. with a ruler only
   C. in capital letters only
   D. by hand without a ruler or stencil

9. The sol-fa syllable m is pronounced (1 mark)
   A. moh
   B. mah
   C. me
   D. may

10. The Kodaly hand sign for d is (1 mark)
   A. a flat hand held level
   B. a pointing finger
   C. a sloping palm
   D. a closed fist

11. A well known children's song that uses only m r d is (1 mark)
   A. The national anthem
   B. A song with many notes
   C. A drum solo
   D. Hot Cross Buns

12. Before joining a coil to a slab you should (1 mark)
   A. scratch both and dab a little water
   B. paint them
   C. dry them in the sun
   D. cover with oil

13. The home note of the melodies in this lesson is (1 mark)
   A. r
   B. m
   C. d
   D. none of them

14. What should you do after crossing the finish line? (1 mark)
   A. Turn around fast
   B. Stop suddenly
   C. Push others
   D. Slow down gradually

15. What is the first command at the start of a race? (1 mark)
   A. Go
   B. Set
   C. On your marks
   D. Stop

16. Why should the knees lift high when sprinting? (1 mark)
   A. To give a stronger, longer stride
   B. To trip others
   C. To slow down
   D. To look funny

17. In a crab balance, your body should look like (1 mark)
   A. a spear
   B. a ball
   C. a table
   D. a snake

18. A side roll is also called a (1 mark)
   A. log roll
   B. crab roll
   C. frog roll
   D. star roll

19. Why do we stand up slowly after a side roll? (1 mark)
   A. To win a prize
   B. To avoid feeling dizzy
   C. To look tall
   D. To make noise

20. How does gymnastics help the heart and lungs? (1 mark)
   A. It removes the lungs
   B. Moving the whole body makes the heart beat faster and stay strong
   C. It stops the heart
   D. It has no effect

21. Which is good etiquette for a performer? (1 mark)
   A. Turn your back
   B. Push others
   C. Talk during the song
   D. Walk on and off the stage quietly

22. A sacred song is (1 mark)
   A. a work song only
   B. a song of worship
   C. a song with no words
   D. a song about a football match

23. In music, the sign f means (1 mark)
   A. loud
   B. slow
   C. silent
   D. soft

24. Which is good singing posture? (1 mark)
   A. Hiding behind others
   B. Bending over
   C. Standing tall with shoulders relaxed
   D. Slouching

25. The flash is (1 mark)
   A. the screen
   B. the strap
   C. a small light for dark places
   D. the button

26. Which note is played with the thumb and holes 1 and 2 covered? (1 mark)
   A. B
   B. G
   C. D
   D. A

27. In the sit-and-slide entry, you should turn (1 mark)
   A. away from the wall
   B. to the deep end
   C. to face the wall and hold the edge
   D. upside down

28. Which Kiswahili word means crab? (1 mark)
   A. kaa
   B. mamba
   C. simba
   D. chura

29. The snake slither is done (1 mark)
   A. hopping
   B. standing on tiptoe
   C. running fast
   D. lying on the tummy and wriggling forward

30. On which occasion may the national anthem be sung? (1 mark)
   A. A private joke
   B. Never
   C. Madaraka Day celebrations
   D. Only at night

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe the game hawk and the chicks. (4 marks)

32. Explain what a relay race is and how it teaches teamwork. (4 marks)

33. Give four safety rules when making charcoal sticks. (4 marks)

34. Explain how to make a shade of green. (2 marks)

35. Describe how to paint the Kenyan flag on paper. (5 marks)

36. Describe how to play the note G on the descant recorder and explain how to get a good tone. (5 marks)

37. What are the sol-fa syllables for the three notes learned, and which is the lowest? (2 marks)

38. Describe how to blow to make a good tone. (3 marks)

39. Why do we improvise a netball? (3 marks)

40. Describe how to make flour paste glue. (3 marks)

41. Why should you never point a camera directly at the sun? (3 marks)

42. What is a balance in gymnastics? (2 marks)

43. List four steps of the medium start. (4 marks)

44. Explain how the elongated start is different from the medium start. (4 marks)

45. Why is colour classification important in painting? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #4 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — GK
   The Goal Keeper guards the goal and defends against the shooter.

2. D — Move into space to receive it again
   Moving into open space keeps the game flowing.

3. A — When a defender is standing close
   The ball goes over the defender's arms.

4. B — Purple mixed with white
   White makes a tint.

5. B — With a damp brush
   A damp brush joins the tones smoothly.

6. B — The back pieces
   You paste the back ones first and then those in front.

7. B — Three
   Orange, green and purple are the three secondary colours.

8. D — by hand without a ruler or stencil
   Free hand means using only your hand.

9. C — me
   The syllable m is me.

10. D — a closed fist
   Doh is shown with a fist.

11. D — Hot Cross Buns
   Hot Cross Buns uses only three notes.

12. A — scratch both and dab a little water
   Scratching and wetting help the clay pieces stick.

13. C — d
   Melodies feel finished when they end on d.

14. D — Slow down gradually
   Slowing down gradually is safer.

15. C — On your marks
   The starter first says on your marks.

16. A — To give a stronger, longer stride
   High knees produce a powerful stride.

17. C — a table
   Arms and legs are the table legs, and the body is the top.

18. A — log roll
   Keeping the body straight like a log gives it the name log roll.

19. B — To avoid feeling dizzy
   Getting up too fast can make you dizzy.

20. B — Moving the whole body makes the heart beat faster and stay strong
   Active movement strengthens the heart and lungs.

21. D — Walk on and off the stage quietly
   Good manners show respect for the audience and others.

22. B — a song of worship
   Sacred songs praise God, give thanks or teach faith.

23. A — loud
   The letter f stands for loud.

24. C — Standing tall with shoulders relaxed
   Good posture helps breathing.

25. C — a small light for dark places
   The flash gives extra light.

26. D — A
   A uses thumb, 1 and 2.

27. C — to face the wall and hold the edge
   You hold the edge as you lower yourself in.

28. A — kaa
   Kaa is a crab.

29. D — lying on the tummy and wriggling forward
   The body moves side to side like a snake.

30. C — Madaraka Day celebrations
   It is sung on national days and at official events.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: A hen stands in front and chicks hold on behind in a line. A hawk tries to tag the last chick. The hen spreads her arms and blocks. When the last chick is tagged, roles change.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid part.

32. (4 marks)
   Answer: A relay is a race in which each runner in a team runs a short distance and passes a baton to the next runner. The team wins by working together and passing smoothly.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for team running, 1 mark for the baton, 2 marks for teamwork explanation.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: An adult does the burning; keep far from the fire; leave the tin closed until cold; collect only dead twigs; wash hands afterwards. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct rule.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: Add a small amount of black to green, and more if needed.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for black, 1 mark for adding a little.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: Cut a rectangle of paper in the ratio three to two. Draw the stripes and the thin white lines lightly with a ruler. Sketch the shield and the crossed spears in the middle. Paint black at the top, red in the middle and green at the bottom, leaving the white lines. Let it dry and attach it to a stick.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for the rectangle, drawing stripes, shield, colour order and drying with handle.

36. (5 marks)
   Answer: Hold the recorder with the left hand at the top and the right at the bottom. Cover the thumb hole and holes 1, 2 and 3 with the pads of the left fingers. Put the mouthpiece between the lips and blow gently and steadily with a soft too.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for holding, thumb hole, three holes, mouthpiece and gentle breath.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: d, r and m. d is the lowest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for naming, 1 mark for the lowest.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Put the mouthpiece between the lips, take a deep breath, blow gently and steadily, and start each note with a soft too or doo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Some schools do not have enough balls. We can use materials we have, such as string and waste cloth. It lets more learners practise.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Mix flour with a little cold water to a smooth paste. An adult adds hot water while stirring. Let it cool before use.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: It can hurt your eyes and the strong light will spoil the picture.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for eyes, 1 mark for picture, 1 mark for explanation.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: A position held still for a few seconds under control.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for still position, 1 mark for control or holding.

43. (4 marks)
   Answer: Front foot about one and a half foot lengths behind the line; kneel on the rear knee level with the middle of the front foot; hands behind the line shoulder-width apart; on set, lift the hips a little above the shoulders.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: The rear knee is placed further back, level with the heel of the front foot. The feet are further apart. The push is longer and stronger but may feel less steady.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid difference or explanation, up to 4.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: It helps us know which colours to mix to get others. It shows that only primary colours are needed to make all the other colours.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.
